name: dsh-desktop
description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) macOS desktop shell — Electron
author: dsh-desktop
//repository: GitHub Releases 更新源（D4）：签名/公证后启用自动更新时使用。

scripts.check:host: node -e "require('fs').existsSync('host/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js') || (console.error('缺少 host 包：请先运行 npm run bundle:host'), process.exit(1))"
scripts.pack:dir: npm run build && npm run check:host && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run check:host && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:all: npm run build && npm run check:host && electron-builder --mac --arm64
